name: @nepali-date-picker/workspace
description: npm workspace root for the Nepali Date Picker JavaScript packages (conversion engine + web component).

scripts.build: npm run pack:core && npm run --workspace @nepali-date-picker/web-component build
scripts.build:examples: npm run pack:core && npm run --workspace @nepali-date-picker/web-component build && npm run --workspace @nepali-date-picker/examples build
scripts.test: npm run pack:core && npm run --workspace @nepali-date-picker/web-component test
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules examples/dist examples/node_modules node_modules
